objective: Screen a layer-safe outer-FFN scale while preserving the structurally causal addressed/global RWKV MoE and exact projected-only zero-state identity.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: All four ranks passed exact-zero, finiteness, donor, layer-permutation, and materiality gates, but the 0.03125 per-layer outer residual produced 12.84375 to 15.09375 maximum logit deltas and violated the 2.0 bound.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Decouple the outer-FFN amplitude from the attention-side hybrid gain and reduce only the per-layer post-MLP residual by 64x to 1/2048.

architecture.outer_ffn_scale_response: The outer residual is bounded independently at 1/2048 per layer instead of reusing the 1/32 attention correction bound.
architecture.outer_ffn: identity-initialized recurrent down projection, query-conditioned sigmoid gate, SiLU, and delta-o-initialized up projection
architecture.outer_ffn_placement: after Gemma's frozen MLP and before the decoder residual addition
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero addressed and global recurrence makes both the attention correction and outer FFN residual exactly zero.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked supervised causal training run on the remaining source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and do not open that endpoint.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, the unused strength holdout, or native generation.
